section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the statistical analyses performed, including principal-axis exploratory factor analysis (EFA) for the BAS-2, independent-samples t-tests to compare scores between women and men, and one-sample t-tests to compare participants with a community sample from Tylka and Wood-Barcalow's (2015b) Study 3. Bivariate correlations were also used to assess convergent validity between body appreciation, BMI, self-esteem, life satisfaction, and weight discrepancy (for women).
